intro: As Above, So Below is a mission given by Hilda the Breaker at Bandarion Keep to confront a hidden Scourge infiltration beneath nearby Shadowvale. By recovering bones still humming with fresh reanimation magic, defenders seek to understand how the undead gathered undetected right under the town.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While the Tarnished in Shadowvale to the southwest are definitely a problem, we cannot allow the cellars below the town to fester into a full-blown Scourge uprising on Bandarion Keep.
I need to get these trainees up to snuff in case that happens. You, however, are going to receive what I like to call a crash course.
Travel beneath Shadowvale and retrieve some of their wretched bones so we can study them further. I need ones that still retain some of the initial reanimation magic--that's glowing ones.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You'd best not be returning empty-handed. I either need the bones I asked for, or your body on a stretcher to confirm you at least gave it your all trying to get them.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, adventurer. With these bones we may be able to better understand how such a threat was able to go unnoticed for so long.
